meta.name: arize-dataset
meta.description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when creating, managing, or querying Arize datasets and examples. Also use when the user needs test data or evaluation examples for their model. Covers dataset CRUD, appending examples, exporting data, and file-based dataset creation using the ax CLI.

copy.tagline: 创建、管理和查询Arize数据集与示例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Arize平台上管理数据集和评估示例
copy.tagline_en: Create, manage, and query Arize datasets and examples
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage datasets and evaluation examples on Arize

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以使用 ax 命令行工具在 Arize 平台上创建、查看、导出、追加和删除数据集。
howto.when: 当用户需要管理 Arize 数据集或示例，例如创建测试数据或评估示例时触发。

say.text: 列出当前空间的所有数据集。
say.note: 执行 ax datasets list 命令。

say.text: 从 test.json 文件创建一个名为“测试集”的数据集。
say.note: 执行 ax datasets create 命令。

say.text: 向数据集“my-dataset”追加一条问答示例。
say.note: 执行 ax datasets append 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the ax CLI to create, view, export, append, and delete datasets on the Arize platform.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to manage Arize datasets or examples, such as creating test data or evaluation examples.

say_en.text: List all datasets in the current space.
Create a dataset named "test_set" from test.json.
Append a Q&A example to dataset "my-dataset".
